clues.text: In Philippi, this woman who listened to Paul by the river was a dealer in purple cloth.
This woman who heard Paul preach at Philippi came from the city of Thyatira.
On the Sabbath outside Philippi's gate, Paul met this God-worshiping woman at a riverside place of prayer.
As this woman listened to Paul in Philippi, the Lord opened her heart to respond.
She and her household were baptized after hearing Paul's message in Philippi.
Asking to be counted a believer, this Philippi woman persuaded Paul and his companions to stay at her house.
Released from the Philippian prison, Paul and Silas went to her house to encourage the brothers.
